description:
**Not yet a finding — a probe to fill an audit gap.**

The workspace AGENTS.md 'Security testing' section says the log-capture canary tripwire (pattern 2) is REQUIRED for any module that emits tracing::* events with an argument that interpolates a secret-bearing type via ? or % syntax. Reference precedent: crate-jmap-base-client/tests/common/log_capture.rs + crate-jmap-base-client/tests/log_redaction.rs.

Workspace state: log_capture.rs exists in exactly TWO places — jmap-base-client (precedent) and jmap-metadata-server (tests/common/log_capture.rs, declared via `pub mod log_capture;` in tests/common/mod.rs).

NONE of the other 7 extension-server crates carry a log_capture.rs. This may be:
(a) correct, if those crates emit no tracing::* events that interpolate secret-bearing types — in which case no action;
(b) a gap, if any of those crates does emit such events and the canary is missing.

This probe is to determine which.

**Audit procedure**:
1. For each of mail-server, chat-server, contacts-server, calendars-server, tasks-server, filenode-server, sharing-server:
   - rg 'tracing::(trace|debug|info|warn|error)' src/
   - For each hit, classify the interpolated args: are any of them types that the workspace AGENTS.md 'Per-type Debug redaction canary' rule applies to (e.g. wrappers around credentials, session tokens, blob bytes, verification codes, invite codes, secret-bearing types from jmap-base-client)?
   - If yes → that crate needs a log_capture.rs canary modeled on metadata-server's.
2. For the audit result, file follow-up beads ONLY for crates where the audit identifies a real secret-bearing interpolation; do NOT pre-position canaries against speculative future risk.

**Expected outcome**:
- Most likely: the audit finds zero or one secret-bearing interpolation outside metadata-server, because the extension-server crates are mostly storage-shape and don't handle credentials directly (the base-client is the credentials boundary). The probe closes with 'no propagation needed; metadata-server's canary is sufficient'.
- If audit finds 2+: file a sweep bead to propagate canaries to those crates only.

**Why this is a probe and not a finding**: I did not run the audit; the prior workspace-API review pass also did not. Filing this gives the next reviewer a concrete checklist to discharge rather than a fabricated 'every server crate must have log_capture.rs' bead that would be unwarranted.
title: Probe: audit each extension-server crate for tracing::* call sites that interpolate secret-bearing types; propagate metadata-server's tests/common/log_capture.rs canary to crates that need one
